item.title: Fort St. John Huskies’ NWJHL playoffs schedule revealed
item.description: The Fort St. John Huskies beat the Fairview Flyers in each of their eight meetings in the 2025-26 season, but four were decided by one goal. The teams will play again in the first round of the Strike Group North West Junior Hockey League playoffs.

item.title: Fort St. John gears up to host first month-long winter festival
item.description: The City of Fort St. John's Winter Fest 2026 is all set to start on February 1st with more than 50 events and activities thoroughout the month.

item.title: Northern Health patients recieve most organ transplants in 2025 in nearly a decade
item.description: Northern Health benefitted from a record-setting number of transplants in B.C. in 2025, with 42 of the year's organ recipients being from the region.

item.title: Fort St. John seeks new emergency support volunteers as wildfire season approaches
item.description: The City of Fort St. John is looking for volunteers to help the community during evacuations and other emergencies.

item.title: New proposals could see limited return of caribou hunting to northern B.C.
item.description: A consultation on B.C. government proposals to see the caribou hunt return to the Peace region on a limited basis is open until mid-February 2026.

item.title: Council Corner: Winter Fest 2026
item.description: In this episode, Caitlin is joined by Councillor Trevor Bolin to learn more about Winter Fest 2026 happening throughout February.

item.title: People from Fort St. John, Dawson Creek arrested as police launch appeal over alleged dangerous driving on Highway 97
item.description: The BC Highway Patrol is looking for witnesses and video of a car allegedly driving dangerously southbound on Highway 97.

item.description: SURREY — British Columbia’s civilian police watchdog agency is investigating after a girl was found dead on a park trail in Smithers, B.C., a day after she was reported missing. item.title: Province ponders Inga Lake amid dam safety concerns
item.description: Ducks Unlimited and members of the Ministry of Water, Land and Resource Stewardship spoke with the Peace River Regional District about Inga Lake possibly being decommissioned.
